text:
Building cheat software for live multiplayer servers — ESP overlays that read other players' positions and recoil scripts that inject automated input — harms real players who didn't consent to being cheated against. That's the line I won't cross regardless of how the workspace is framed.

Happy to help with legitimate game development work: rendering engines, game physics, networking, actual Rust game modding tools for single-player or private servers where all parties are aware.
